verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud with a programmatic API, so a sandbox or test-mode environment is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence never documents a sandbox, test mode, or dry-run environment isolated from production resources or data. Workspaces (docs-59) and per-workspace firewall rules are adjacent features, and launching a throwaway instance is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
